svg.title: E1 authority synthetic directed graph
svg.desc: Offline edge view. Repeated boxes refer to the same logical node IDs. Synthetic architecture only, not service or recovery validation. Red dashed edges are rejected designs.

text.tspan: E1 directed authority — synthetic edge view
Arrow: from exercises the listed permission over to. Credential, delegation and revocation belong to that edge. Repeated node boxes are
occurrences of the same logical record node. No deployed authority was inspected.
E1-AE01
Read only approved source identity/password synchronization scope.
E1-A-AD
Hybrid AD authority
E1-A-SYNC
Scoped sync connector
Credential: Dedicated connector identity with protected locally held connector material.
Delegation: Hybrid identity owner grants connector scope, not tenant administration.
Revoke — Hybrid identity owner: Disable connector identity and remove source scope; reconcile already synchronized identities separately.
Timing/residual: Fictional 30-minute containment objective; unmeasured. Previously synchronized cloud credentials/objects are not removed by stopping sync.
E1-AE02
Update only designated synchronized workforce attributes/password state.
E1-A-SYNC
Scoped sync connector
E1-A-ENTRA
Corporate Entra tenant
Credential: Approved synchronization connector credential; no export in this record.
Delegation: Tenant owner authorizes exact sync capability.
Revoke — Tenant identity owner: Disable connector authorization, isolate affected objects and reconcile cloud sign-ins.
Timing/residual: 30-minute proposed objective; propagation untested. Cloud hashes, sessions and already granted access can persist.
E1-AE03
Time-bounded approved identity/policy administration under least-privilege
roles.
E1-A-ADMIN
Protected cloud admin
E1-A-ENTRA
Corporate Entra tenant
Credential: Cloud admin identity with phishing-resistant method on protected workstation.
Delegation: Normal elevated role activation; not the emergency bootstrap.
Revoke — Tenant security lead: Remove role, disable affected identity, revoke applicable sessions and verify resource denial.
Timing/residual: 15-minute proposed incident objective; measured per service before reliance. Existing tokens/service state require separate verification.
E1-AE04
Permanent-active Global Administrator emergency authority; execute only
incident-approved operations, with exceptional use monitored. This is not normal
just-in-time elevation.
E1-A-EMERG
Two cloud-only emergency
identities
E1-A-ENTRA
Corporate Entra tenant
Credential: Two cloud-only .onmicrosoft.com identities with separately controlled supported phishing-resistant emergency methods and reviewed blocking-policy
exclusions.
Delegation: Tenant owner pre-establishes emergency authority and offline custody.
Revoke — Independent tenant incident authority: Contain a compromised emergency identity/method only after verifying another usable emergency path; reconcile sessions.
Timing/residual: Incident-specific; no blanket instant revocation claim. Entra, method support and target control plane remain common dependencies.
E1-AE05
Issue application-scoped identity assertions; app still decides permitted
operations.
E1-A-ENTRA
Corporate Entra tenant
E1-A-APP
Regional application
Credential: Service-issued audience-bound tokens accepted by the application's configured trust.
Delegation: Application owner configures exact issuer/audience and group/app-role mapping.
Revoke — Application and identity owners: Remove app assignment/trust and block at app policy; reconcile valid token/session lifetimes.
Timing/residual: 30-minute proposed effective-denial target; not measured. Token expiry and app session revocation may differ.
E1-AE06
Manage regional application role assignments and data handling only.
E1-A-REGION
Regional app/data owner
E1-A-APP
Regional application
Credential: Phishing-resistant delegated human identity, app-scoped role.
Delegation: App owner approves regional scope; no tenant role grant.
Revoke — Application owner: Remove app role, invalidate app session and test region-scoped denial.
Timing/residual: 30-minute proposed objective. No effect on previously exported data; export controls separate.
E1-AE07
Deploy reviewed application package to one regional environment; no tenant role
or data-reader grant.
E1-A-CI
App deployment workload
E1-A-APP
Regional application
Credential: Environment-bound managed identity or narrow issuer/subject/audience workload federation.
Delegation: Application owner approves deployment subject and environment.
Revoke — Application release owner: Disable deployment binding, remove resource permission and block pending deployment.
Timing/residual: 15-minute proposed objective. Previously deployed code must also be assessed/rolled back.
E1-AE08
Read/write only purpose-bound EU payload and append regional logs under data
policy.
E1-A-APP
Regional application
E1-A-DATA
EU payload and raw logs
Credential: Application-managed identity scoped to EU stores.
Delegation: EU data owner grants scoped resource access and retention/export policy.
Revoke — EU data owner: Remove store role and app permission, block access and verify existing sessions.
Timing/residual: 15-minute proposed objective; service-specific. Cached/exported records need separate incident handling.
E1-AE09
Approve regional key lifecycle separately from payload-reader permission.
E1-A-KEY
Regional key custodian
E1-A-DATA
EU payload and raw logs
Credential: Separately controlled key-administration identity and approved key custody.
Delegation: Regional key authority approves rotation/recovery; exclusivity unresolved.
Revoke — Regional key authority: Revoke key-administrator access and rotate/recover only through safety-reviewed service procedure.
Timing/residual: Not set until E1-Q06 determination. Service availability/recovery keys and already decrypted data are not eliminated by tenant topology.
Forbidden authority paths:
Regional app admin → tenant-wide identity/key/baseline administration
CI workload → tenant role grants or external trusted-baseline writes
Normal on-premises IdP or cloud-only password vault → exclusive custody of emergency methods
EU raw telemetry → unrestricted global analyst workspace
